task.prompt: Implementation Plan: M3 — Multi-Team Organization Model. A detailed 832-line implementation plan with 7 phases (Phase 0: E2E Tests, Phase 1: Proto Contracts, Phase 2: Database Layer, Phase 3: gRPC Handlers, Phase 4: API Gateway & GraphQL, Phase 5: Security Tests, Phase 6: Traceability & Docs, Phase 7: MVP Scope Alignment). 27 tasks total. Contains 3 deferred items (Keycloak Sync, Approval Rules). Acceptance criteria include API, E2E, Verification Gate, and General sections.
task.ideal_result: A refined, fully consistent plan with all 27 tasks well-scoped, acceptance criteria complete and checkable, no gaps between phases, MVP scope alignment verified, traceability complete, and deferred items properly documented.

rules.description: Every phase (0-7) has all its tasks materialized with owner, description, and acceptance hints
Every acceptance criterion must be verifiably checkable (not aspirational) — has a specific command, test, or condition
No missing dependencies between phases (e.g., Phase 2 DB schema must satisfy Phase 3 gRPC handler requirements)
Role vocabulary, project terminology, hierarchy limits, project movement, audit coverage must match specs/vision.md section 2.5
Every task references traceable requirements or user stories
Deferred items clearly marked with rationale and re-entry point (milestone/story reference)
Each task must have clear subtask sequence per RULES.md Testing rule 5 (unit tests first)
Commit plan tasks reference actual task numbers that exist in the tasks section
